This 'melting' of limbs into the heavy fur is a subtle structural artifact that the Router missed but the pose auditor flagged via uncertainty. This suggests minor structural melting/fusion typical of AI generation when handling dense fur occluding joints. The perceptual quality is good (no noise/blur), but the anatomical definition is compromised by this fusion, lowering the artifact score below the perfect 5.0.
